BIG Mgr Callback Msg

group BIG_MGR_CALLBACK_MSG

Used to identify BIG Manager Callback Message.

Defines

MSG_BIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH 0x60

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_setup_data_path. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_SETUP_DATA_PATH_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER and BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_REMOVE_DATA_PATH 0x61

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_remove_data_path. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_REMOVE_DATA_PATH_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER and BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_ISO_TEST_END 0x70

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_iso_test_end. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_ISO_TEST_END_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER and BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_TRANSMIT_TEST 0x74

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_transmit_test. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_TRANSMIT_TEST_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_RECEIVE_TEST 0x78

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_receive_test. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_RECEIVE_TEST_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_READ_TEST_COUNTERS 0x79

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_read_test_counters. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_READ_TEST_COUNTERS_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_ISOC_BROADCAST_STATE_CHANGE_INFO 0x80

Information msg type for Isochronous Broadcaster broadcasting state. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_ISOC_BROADCAST_STATE_CHANGE_INFO. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_ISOC_BROADCASTER_CREATE_BIG_CMPL_INFO 0x81

Information msg type for gap_big_mgr_isoc_broadcaster_create_big. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_ISOC_BC_CREATE_BIG_CMPL_INFO. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_READ_ISO_TX_SYNC 0x82

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_read_iso_tx_sync. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_READ_ISO_TX_SYNC_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_ISOC_BROADCASTER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_SYNC_RECEIVER_DEV_STATE_CHANGE_INFO 0x90

Information msg type for Synchronized Receiver device state. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_SYNC_RECEIVER_DEV_STATE_CHANGE_INFO. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_SYNC_RECEIVER_SYNC_STATE_CHANGE_INFO 0x91

Information msg type for Synchronized Receiver synchronous state. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_SYNC_RECEIVER_SYNC_STATE_CHANGE_INFO. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_SYNC_RECEIVER_BIG_SYNC_ESTABLISHED_INFO 0x92

Information msg type for gap_big_mgr_sync_receiver_big_create_sync. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_SYNC_RECEIVER_BIG_SYNC_ESTABLISHED_INFO. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.

MSG_BIG_MGR_READ_ISO_LINK_QUALITY 0x93

Response msg type for gap_big_mgr_read_iso_link_quality. The structure of callback data is T_BIG_MGR_READ_ISO_LINK_QUALITY_RSP. Used for BIG_MGR_ROLE_SYNC_RECEIVER.
